findings.action: Metadata read errors can become an empty selection policy. scopeMetadataAt returns empty metadata whenever both git show and cat-file -e fail, although a missing or unreadable blob is not proof that the path is absent from the tree. workingFileDiffersFromHead at lines 713-714 likewise treats any Git read failure as equality when the working file is absent. Consequently, with a valid base declaring b dependsOn a, an unavailable metadata blob and an absent working metadata file can pass both guards, discard the dependency, and carry b after a changes. Administrative metadata deletion is permitted by material cleanliness, and the name-only diff need not read the unavailable blob. This violates R2's full-run fallback on uncertainty and D1's selection premise. Determine absence from the pinned tree and return errors for failed object reads; add a regression for an unavailable committed metadata blob. Source-established; a new corruption fixture could not be created in the read-only sandbox.
